notes: The ASV writes negation and modal as two words, so לֹא takes only 'not' and 'could' stays with the verb (rule 35); the verb's unit is discontinuous around it.
'There was' is the construction's presentative frame and joins דְּמָמָה rather than being added (rules 20, 21), the italics corroborating nothing either way (rule 7).
The italicized 'saying' introduces the following speech and answers to no morpheme in this verse, so it is added (rule 30).
